description: Reads the HTTP API of a third party the organization declared as a connection: GET, or POST with body on a path it declares as a read; nothing else goes out. Its rights, rules and function apply; while adds the authentication and keeps a trace of the call.

body.description: Only on a path declared as a read (POST): an object (sent as JSON) or text.

path.description: Path at the provider, with its query string: /api/v1/slots?site=origines.

name: read_connection
title: Read a connection's API
